author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I implemented the world slowest web calculator

Busicom 141-pf with Intel 4004 running on a SystemVerilog simulator

100% vibe coding, zero hand coded. AI implemented the whole thing, RTL and the web interface with no human input. The AI reads the 4004 data sheet, the Busicom user manual and source code of the firmware, and eventually figured everything out itself.

But, it got stuck quite a few times, I have to keep encouraging the AI to work harder, tell it that it has make mistakes (I didn't give it the solution, I just asked it to look again). I build it with with GLM-5.3, Muse-1.3 and GPT-6 Sol, where ever I have spare tokens in the weekly limit. Maybe Fable or Astra can one-shot design. Someone should add this task to one of those AI benchmark.

I got a feeling that with the firmware source code, Fable or Astra may able to implement it. It would be a much bigger challenger if we don't let AI see the firmware source code. I am not sure AI is smart enough to figure out all those crazy 4-bit optimization tricks to make the firmware fits within1kB

https://lnkd.in/d5rYQJJD

replies.text:
Kempton Lam I want to test how good AI actually is in building chips.  I asked AI start building old chips in the early days of computer, because if AI can't build a tiny old chips, there is no way it can build the big chip that my day job is working on.

at least for now, my job is pretty safe.  AI can't build a 4-bit tiny CPU on its own yet.  I didn't correct it as in giving it the answer, I just told it is not right, keep looking.

AI still don't know what is right from wrong.
